stories.headline: OpenAI plans to cut Cursor model access
stories.summary: OpenAI plans to stop supplying models to SpaceX-owned Cursor, citing uncertainty over compliance with its terms. Cursor says talks continue, while Anthropic plans additional Claude capacity. Shutoff is proposed for November 12.

stories.headline: US announces Venezuela oil-control agreement
stories.summary: President Trump announced majority U.S. control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan reserves. The structure was not disclosed, and analysts said legal, infrastructure and investment obstacles make the outcome uncertain.

stories.headline: Nepal seeks technical help after deadly floods
stories.summary: Nepal temporarily halted rescue work in poor weather after floods killed at least 626 people there and seven in Tibet; nearly 3,000 remain missing. Initial rebuilding needs are estimated at $4–5 billion, but assessments continue.

stories.headline: Kyiv-area warehouse detonation kills 27
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials said a Russian drone strike triggered a warehouse detonation near Kyiv, killing at least 27 and injuring 42. The toll may rise; criminal cases are examining possible negligence over ammunition storage.

stories.headline: Norway mourns King Harald; Haakon succeeds him
stories.summary: Norway is mourning King Harald, who died Friday at 89 after more than three decades on the throne. His son immediately became King Haakon VIII and is expected to address the nation before taking the parliamentary oath Tuesday.
